summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests JNJ-89862175, an antibody drug conjugate that targets ENPP3, in people with advanced solid tumors. The record does not state how the drug is given or how often. The study aims to find the recommended phase 2 doses in Part 1 and to further evaluate safety at those doses in Part 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa JNJ-89862175, un conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco dirigido a ENPP3, en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados. El registro no indica cómo se administra el medicamento ni con qué frecuencia. El estudio busca determinar las dosis recomendadas para fase 2 en la Parte 1 y evaluar con más detalle la seguridad a esas dosis en la Parte 2.
who_for: Confirmed metastatic or unresectable solid tumor: lung adenocarcinoma, clear cell or papillary renal cell carcinoma, endometrioid ovarian, or endometrioid uteri
ECOG performance status of 0 to 1 at screening.
Not pregnant or breastfeeding, and agree to avoid pregnancy and egg or sperm donation during the study and for 4 months after the last dose.
not_for: Active central nervous system involvement, unless clinically stable.
Clinically significant cardiovascular disease within 6 months before informed consent.
History of solid organ or hematologic stem cell transplant.
Known allergy, hypersensitivity, or intolerance to excipients of JNJ-89862175.
Prior or current second malignancy likely to interfere with safety or efficacy assessment.
